BLD.Settings.PromptOnManual.Name: Prompt on manual bleed
BLD.Settings.PromptOnManual.Hint: Ask for an amount and type when the condition is applied by hand. @Bleed and the API are unaffected.
BLD.Prompt.MarkerNote: Marker Only leaves the condition inert — no automatic damage.
BLD.Prompt.Title: Apply Bleed — {name}
BLD.Prompt.DeepNote: 0 = ordinary bleed. Higher closes only through that much dedicated healing.
BLD.Enricher.TooltipDeep: Apply deep bleed ({kind}): {formula} — {deep} HP of dedicated healing to close
BLD.Enricher.NoTarget: Bleed: no target. Select or target a token first.
BLD.Display.Heading: Bleed
BLD.Display.HighestNote: Highest of each type applies each round.
BLD.Display.DeepNote: Deep: closes only through dedicated healing.
BLD.Display.SourceNote: Buff bleed ends with the buff.
BLD.Display.BlockedNote: Blocked: no healing until the cause is gone.
BLD.Deep.CannotClear: {name}'s deep bleed still needs {remaining} HP of dedicated healing.
BLD.Settings.HealingStops.Name: Healing stops bleed
BLD.Settings.HealingStops.Hint: Restoring hit points ends ordinary bleeding. Hand-edited totals (the sheet's HP field, the token's health bar) don't count, and deep bleeds are unaffected.
BLD.Healing.Stops: {name} is healed, and the bleeding stops.
BLD.Settings.Homebrew.Name: Astora Homebrew rules
BLD.Settings.Homebrew.Hint: Enables non-RAW rules (currently Deep Bleed). Needs pf1-critical-effects' matching setting too. Off stops new ones only.
BLD.Burning.Ignite: {name} catches fire and takes {total} fire damage.
BLD.Burning.IgniteResisted: {name} catches fire, but shrugs off the flames entirely.
BLD.Burning.PartlyOut: {name} puts out some of the flames, but is still burning ({n} left).
BLD.Burning.AutoDamage: {name} takes {total} fire damage from the flames.
BLD.Burning.Resisted: {name} keeps burning, but shrugs off the flames entirely.
BLD.Burning.Immune: {name} is immune to fire and cannot be set alight.
BLD.Burning.SaveFlavor: {name} is on fire: Reflex DC {dc} to put it out.
BLD.Burning.ExtinguishFlavor: {name} tries to put out the flames
BLD.Burning.NothingToPutOut: {name} has no flames a save can put out.
BLD.Burning.NotYourTurn: {name} can only do this on its own turn.
BLD.Burning.Display.Heading: Burning
BLD.Burning.Card.HighestNote: Only the fiercest deals damage each round.
BLD.Burning.Card.SaveButton: Reflex Save (DC {dc}) to put out the flames
BLD.Burning.ExtinguishCard.Beats: {name} tries to put out the flames ({total}), enough for:
BLD.Burning.ExtinguishCard.Fails: {name} tries to put out the flames ({total}), but none go out.
BLD.Burning.ExtinguishCard.AlreadyOut: Those flames on {name} are already out.
BLD.Burning.Enricher.TooltipCatch: Set on fire (1d6 now and each round, Reflex DC 15 each turn to put out)
BLD.Burning.Enricher.TooltipBurn: Set alight ({damage} fire/round, Reflex DC {dc} to put out, {rounds})
BLD.Burning.Enricher.NoTarget: Burning: no target. Select or target a token first.
BLD.Settings.Resistance.Name: Burning respects fire resistance
BLD.Settings.Resistance.Hint: Run burning damage through fire resistance and vulnerability. Off applies it flat. Immunity always applies.
BLD.Buff.BleedHint: Dealt each round while active. Blank = inert marker.
BLD.Buff.ModePersistHint: Inflicted once on activation; stays after the buff ends.
BLD.Buff.BurningHint: Fire damage each round while active. Blank = 1d6. Ends only with the buff.
BLD.DoT.Heading: Damage Over Time
BLD.DoT.Empty: Nothing configured. Click + to add an instance of recurring damage or healing.
BLD.DoT.BypassHint: Lets the damage through reduction these overcome — e.g. tick Magic so DR/magic doesn't absorb it. Only shown for physical damage, which is the only kind DR applies to.
BLD.DoT.IgnoreHardnessHint: Objects and constructs reduce damage of any type by their hardness. Adamantine already ignores hardness of 20 or less.
BLD.DoT.IntervalHint: Counts from when the effect started. Anything longer than a round or two only comes round outside combat.
BLD.DoT.TimingHint: Initiative uses the count the buff was switched on at, and falls back to turn start when there isn't one.
BLD.DoT.Error.NoTarget: Damage over time: no valid target actor.
BLD.Settings.PrivateCards.Name: Owners-only chat cards
BLD.Settings.PrivateCards.Hint: Whisper bleed, burning, and damage over time cards to the creature's owners and the GM instead of posting them to everyone.
BLD.TimeJump.Heading: Time passes
BLD.TimeJump.Truncated: Not resolved within {rounds} rounds; only those are applied.
